name: Misawa Hanei
source:
Hanei Misawa is one of [url=/c78]Akiha Tohno[/url]'s roommates at her school, Asagami Private Girls Academy, along with Tsukihime Souka. Nicknamed 'Hanepin', she is slow-witted, conscientious, thorough and good at fixing things.

[From [url=http://typemoon.wikia.com/wiki/Hanei_Misawa]TYPE-MOON Wiki[/url].]
